brief:
Israeli warplanes struck a mosque and a desalination station in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza City, according to Maan Wire. The bombardment also affected surrounding areas in the residential district.

The dual strike targeted civilian infrastructure serving the population in a densely built neighborhood. Gaza faces acute water scarcity as the conflict continues, making the damage to the desalination facility particularly consequential for residents already struggling to access clean water supplies.
title: Israeli airstrikes damage mosque and desalination plant in Gaza City
